notes: Semantic layer for the state animations. Lives beside the pack so --reindex never discards it.

lottie/loading-spinner.json.description: Indeterminate loading spinner — a 90° arc making one full rotation over 1s. For work whose duration is unknown.

lottie/progress-ring.json.description: Determinate progress ring filling 0→100% over 1.5s, starting at 12 o'clock. For work with a known amount.

lottie/success-check.json.description: Success confirmation — green circle springs in with an overshoot, then the checkmark draws on. Payoff beat for a completed action.

lottie/error-cross.json.description: Failure state — red circle springs in, then two strokes draw the cross in sequence. Counterpart to success-check.

lottie/pulse-dot.json.description: Pulsing beacon — a solid dot with a halo that breathes out and fades. Marks a live or active point; loops cleanly if you place it repeatedly.
